scenes.text: It's Friday, four in the afternoon. You're still building the weekly client report.
You copy numbers out of one app, paste them into a spreadsheet, and fix the formatting by hand.
That's your Friday afternoon, every Friday. And one wrong cell goes straight to your client.
Apple says Numbers on the Mac is getting a way for outside A-I helpers to read and edit your spreadsheets. It's in beta.
So the A-I pulls this week's numbers, fills in Dave's report, and you check it before it's sent.
Promising. But it's Mac only, and it's brand new. Test it on one report first.
Follow. I fix one business process like this every week.
